historical_references.reference: The name Aryesh is believed to be derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arya' meaning 'noble' or 'pure' and the Persian suffix '-esh' meaning 'lord' or 'ruler'. This name was commonly used among the Aryan people of ancient India around 1500 BCE.

Aryesh is also mentioned in the Hindu epic 'Mahabharata' as the name of a great warrior from the Kuru kingdom who fought in the epic battle of Kurukshetra. His father was Bhishma, the grandsire of the Pandavas and the Kauravas.
